_README: Cau hinh gateway cho moi truong Dev.
PLACEHOLDER — repo public. Dien gia tri that o may ban, dung commit file da dien.
Khoa Env phai trung ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT, neu khong Program nem luc khoi dong.
Gateway KHONG xac thuc token: VcbPortalApi tu lam viec do.

RateLimit._IpWhitelist: Cac IP khong bi gioi han. Khai DAY DU o day — cau hinh .NET ghep mang theo chi so, de mot nua o file chung se con sot phan tu cu.

vcbportalapi._HttpRequest: ActivityTimeout: backend treo thi cat sau 30s thay vi giu ket noi 100s nhu mac dinh YARP.
vcbportalapi._HealthCheck: Passive: dem ti le loi truyen tai, hong thi tam loai destination roi thu lai sau ReactivationPeriod. Khong can backend co endpoint health rieng.
